Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Bridge is building financial infrastructure that makes money more programmable and global. The Financial Partnerships team develops the ecosystem that powers Bridge and Stripe’s stablecoin products and financial infrastructure.
The team works across Bridge and Stripe to develop strategic relationships with banks, exchanges, asset managers, liquidity providers, and stablecoin ecosystem partners. These partnerships support reserve management, liquidity, distribution, and card-related products for both businesses and their shared customers.

As a senior Partnership Development Manager, you will define and execute the financial-partnership strategy that powers Bridge and Stripe’s stablecoin products and financial infrastructure.
You will own a strategic ecosystem of financial-partner relationships across markets. You will turn market insight into durable, high-impact partnerships, from strategy and negotiation through launch, expansion, and ongoing performance management. You will work directly with senior Stripe leaders and external executives to make investment tradeoffs, align priorities, and shape long-term product and partnership strategy.

Define and lead multi-year partnership strategy across reserves, liquidity, distribution, card-related products, and the stablecoin ecosystem, using market and commercial insight to shape Bridge and Stripe priorities
Own a strategic financial-partner ecosystem across markets, including partnership health, commercial performance, executive alignment, escalations, and expansion opportunities
Source, evaluate, structure, negotiate, and lead high-impact partnerships with banks, exchanges, asset managers, liquidity providers, and stablecoin ecosystem partners
Set end-to-end deal strategy for complex, novel, or multi-market partnerships with material financial, product, operational, or regulatory implications
Lead company-level tradeoffs across partner economics, customer needs, product requirements, operational readiness, risk, and long-term strategic value
Partner with Product, Treasury, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Finance, Engineering, and go-to-market teams to set requirements, align senior stakeholders, and execute shared priorities
Develop a differentiated point of view on financial services and digital assets, represent Stripe and Bridge with senior external stakeholders, and share expertise that strengthens the broader Partnerships organization

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

12+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, corporate development, strategic finance, treasury, or a related field, including ownership of complex, high-impact external partnerships
Demonstrated ability to independently set partnership strategy, influence senior executives, and drive cross-functional alignment on ambiguous, high-stakes company priorities
Track record of structuring, negotiating, and managing high-value, multi-year partnerships with material strategic, financial, product, operational, or regulatory implications
Deep experience working with financial institutions or infrastructure providers, such as banks, exchanges, asset managers, market makers, liquidity providers, payments companies, or stablecoin ecosystem participants
Strong commercial judgment and experience leading both commercial and technical partnership conversations with senior internal and external stakeholders

Experience in stablecoins, crypto, card issuing, or stablecoin-linked card programs
Experience developing partnership strategy across multiple markets or partner types
Experience representing a company with industry groups, at conferences, or with senior external executives
Experience mentoring or guiding peers on partnership strategy, complex negotiations, or cross-functional execution

Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The SaaS Platform Partnerships team is part of our Go-to-Market organization, and supports new and existing SaaS Platforms in developing and growing their embedded payments and finance businesses. We work closely with platforms as a channel partner to incubate growth tactics and scale them into benefits of our program, Stripe Partner Ecosystem.

PDMs act as the R&D arm of this program — testing new growth approaches with a small number of platforms, measuring what works, and then codifying those tactics into structured resources that Stripe's broader account team can deliver at scale. In parallel, we work with product teams to embed the learnings directly into Stripe’s products.

We are seen as trusted advisors and experts in SaaS Platforms.

This role will be an early EMEA hire for the SaaS Platform Partnerships team, working closely with the GTM team.

There are three key components of this role: (1) providing strategic advisory to strategic platforms, (2) developing and validating EMEA-specific growth tactics, and (3) scaling successful tactics into structured benefits available across the broader Stripe Partner Ecosystem and to SaaS Platforms on Stripe.

You will be an expert on the SaaS Platform business model and be a strategic growth consultant for their business.
PDMs in this role are responsible for managing a small portfolio of strategic platform partners, providing bespoke, multi-quarter growth advisory to help platforms drive new customer acquisition, increase payments adoption, and expand embedded financial products to their existing customer base. Success is measured at both the platform level and the program level, with an emphasis on driving measurable partner outcomes and developing scalable tactics for the broader program.

Serve as a growth advisor for a portfolio of strategic EMEA platform partners - building tailored partnership plans, identifying expansion opportunities, and collaborating cross-functional Stripe resources (sales, product, marketing) to drive measurable growth.
Advise strategic platforms to drive growth of new customers and distribution of Stripe’s products with them as a channel partner.
Identify growth tactics with strategic platform partners, which can scale to benefits of the Stripe Partner Ecosystem and broader platform base.
Represent the program in the region which will include presenting at roundtables and advising platforms in executive customer meetings.
Collaborate closely with GTM teams within the region to drive awareness and adoption of the program.

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Experience identifying and scaling growth initiatives

Experience working in product-centric environment with significant internal and external dependencies
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders internally and externally across a wide variety of functions, including at the C level
Have an operationally focused mindset, with an ability to navigate complex relationship management activities by setting a clear vision, while running tight processes

5+ years of experience related to payments, marketplaces or SaaS platforms
Background in Technical or Product Partnerships
Background in Channel Partnerships, especially in SaaS products
Experience in a sales or go to market role preferably in the payments or SaaS platform space

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. As a Senior Corporate Development Manager, you will help shape Vanta’s long-term growth strategy through strategic partnerships and acquisitions. You will own critical deal workstreams end-to-end and operate as a thought partner to Vanta’s executive team on build, buy, and partner decisions. This is a high-impact role at a pivotal stage of Vanta’s growth, with the opportunity to directly influence product strategy, market expansion, and long-term company trajectory.
This role will be an integral part of Vanta’s Corporate Development team. Vanta Corporate Development is a small but impactful team that is responsible for helping define strategy (buy, build, partner) and driving product & business priorities through the execution of strategic partnerships & acquisitions. Vanta Corporate Development operates cross-functionally driving alignment across EPD, GTM, & Operational teams.
What you’ll do as a Senior Corporate Development Manager at Vanta:
Partner closely with Vanta leaders to define strategy, assess growth opportunities, & build alignment on key priorities
Develop & present business case memos, financial analysis, & executive presentations
Drive CorpDev processes end-to-end including due diligence, strategic thesis / business case development, execution, & post deal integration
Own key financial analysis required to support decision making and negotiations
Build perspectives on key strategic trends, notable VC / M&A activity, and gather/distill competitive intelligence to support Vanta’s strategy
Work cross-functionally across Vanta, including EPD, Operations, GTM, Legal, Finance, & People teams

About Vanta
We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation.

Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.
Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

Position Summary: EASI is BoxPower 's cloud platform for modeling, pricing, and designing solar + storage microgrid projects — turning work that took weeks into minutes. Since its public beta launch in March 2026, external users have modeled $100M+ in project value on the platform.

EASI has strong top-of-funnel growth; this role's job is to turn users into active, successful users — and channel partners into a repeatable pipeline.

The Product & Business Development Associate is the face of EASI to developers, ESCOs, and utility partners: onboarding them, teaching them what's possible, publishing content that shows how, and demoing the platform at industry events.

Internally, they translate what they hear into roadmap input and go-to-market plans alongside the Director of Software Products. This is a high-ownership role for an early-career energy generalist who can hold their own in both a technical modeling conversation and a partner pitch. Roughly 75% business development and growth, 25% product management.

Key Responsibilities: Business development & partner enablement (~40%) Own onboarding and ongoing support for EASI channel partners (ESCOs, developers, EPCs, co-ops) — from NDA to first modeled project to portfolio adoption.

Run product demos: live at conferences and meetups, and scheduled deep-dives with prospective partners; drive on-the-spot signups. Support the sales team in using EASI for their own deals (proposals, budgetary pricing, RFP inputs). Gather structured partner feedback and verify partner-modeled projects as real commercial pipeline.

User engagement & growth (~35%) Own activation and retention of the existing user base: guided first-project onboarding, re-engagement campaigns, and targeted newsletters.

Create technical content — case studies and “how to model X in EASI” walkthroughs (resiliency, bridging power, flexible interconnection) — for LinkedIn, Reddit developer communities, and the blog. Run outbound experiments (cold email/calls to target segments) and identify high-fit events for demos.

Monitor product analytics (MixPanel) to spot stuck users, feature gaps, and conversion candidates. Product management (~25%) Turn user research and partner feedback into clear product requirements and prioritized roadmap input. Drive go-to-market for new EASI features: release messaging, documentation, training material, and demo scripts.

Maintain competitive awareness of adjacent modeling tools (HOMER, Xendee, Energy Toolbase, etc.) and how EASI wins.

Required Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in an energy-related field — electrical/mechanical engineering, physics, energy systems, or similar (or equivalent experience). 0–3 years of post-grad experience in energy, cleantech, consulting, or B2B software. Strong recent graduates are encouraged to apply.

Hands-on exposure to energy modeling tools — e.g. HOMER, Energy Toolbase, Xendee, PVsyst, HelioScope, or REopt — from coursework, research, or work. Excellent communicator — able to explain a techno-economic model to an engineer and its business value to an executive, in writing and live.

Self-directed operator — comfortable owning a number (activation, partner signups) and figuring out how to move it in a startup environment. Able to travel up to 25% for conferences, partner demos, and team onsites.

Preferred Qualifications: Understanding of microgrids, DERs, solar + storage economics, or utility planning and interconnection processes. Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot), product analytics (MixPanel), or content creation for technical audiences. Prior demo, sales engineering, applications engineering, or customer success exposure.

Experience selling to or working with utilities, co-ops, ESCOs, or EPCs. Based in California — Northern California or a West Coast hub is ideal for partner visits and events. Salary: $75,000 - $95,000 Originally posted on Himalayas

s.h: Here is what makes it so great
s.t:
We grow roofing companies by taking away their administrative work and giving them the tools to sell that only big companies would have. Seeing and enabling the growth of talented roofing masters through handly is the most rewarding thing you can imagine.
We earn money through a revenue share of our partner businesses. This aligns our incentives 100% - meaning incredible transparency and trust between us and the craftsmen.
Our craftsmen deliver real value to customers - the young family who wants to renovate their newly bought home. There is incredibly more demand than supply. Our customers’ customers are incredibly thankful, for the service that our partner companies can deliver to them through handly.
You are the owner of this relationship. Together with the owner of the craftsmen company, you will launch the company and grow it to €1M revenue and beyond. You will do that with 10 companies eventually.
Through our revenue share business model, you sit exactly at the most important point of our operation. Your daily work generates handly’s revenue. This makes the role of Venture Development Manager the most critical role of the company. A good point to grow from.

Own the P&L and drive financial performance by proactively identifying revenue growth levers, optimising marketing spend allocation, and rigorously uncovering cost-saving opportunities to ensure long-term profitability
Provide regular reports and updates to the Youfoodz and Hellofresh ANZ Leadership team on progress toward business plan goals and OKRs
Articulate strategic narratives that connect short-term operational execution with long-term business goals
Leverage industry trends, competition news, and market insights to inform growth strategy

Experience navigating regulatory/government frameworks and contracting in new markets
Strong communication and collaboration skills with senior management and cross-functional teams
Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills

Hands-on mentality combined with ability to think strategically

Hey there!
We’re Fever , the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.
Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.
Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?
To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!
Ready to be part of the experience?
Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Fever for Business (F4B) is our B2B organization, built around a simple idea: providing live experiences as a service to other companies.
We help businesses, schools and global brands create memorable events without the usual complexity by providing a reliable, scalable, and high-quality service.

From intimate Candlelight Private Concerts or a large-scale multi-city activation, we turn live entertainment into a repeatable business solution that drives employee engagement and brand differentiation.

Our team owns the full journey, from initial sales and strategy to global execution, working closely with Fever Originals and Operations to scale B2B experiences smoothly and at a global level.
Join us if you are excited about redefining B2B entertainment, build global partnerships, and turn world-class culture into a seamless business service.

As our Account Development Associate, you will drive the pipeline for our ticketed experiences in the corporate space, generate new revenue opportunities, and lead the full sales cycle for group ticket sales. You will qualify and nurture inbound interest, develop highly targeted outbound strategies, and close ticket sales while refining the commercial methodologies that will fuel your growth (and ours).

Drive inbound and outbound pipeline for Fever for Business’ corporate ticketing offering.
Manage and close group ticket sales opportunities, leading the full sales cycle from qualification to payment reception.
Build and optimize outreach sequences, messaging, and cadences to maximize engagement and conversion.
Maintain excellent CRM hygiene and ensure accurate forecasting to keep the team aligned on targets.
Collaborate closely with Billing, with the various Project Managers, and with the Sales team to align campaigns, share insights, and enhance commercial impact.
Track and report key KPIs (SQLs generated, pipeline value, conversion rates, closed-won revenue) and iterate based on performance data.
What success looks like in your first year
3 months: Ramp up on our offering, tools, and messaging. Start closing your first group ticket sales and meet early pipeline targets.
6 months: Consistently generate, qualify, and advance high-quality opportunities for ticketed experiences within companies and institutions. Improve conversion rates through disciplined follow-up and data-driven iteration.
12 months: Become a key revenue driver for Fever for Business, supported by a repeatable sales playbook and strong internal partnerships that accelerate results. Be prepared for promotion.

Strong interest in Sales; proven experience in B2B Sales, ideally in sales development or business development. Experience in media or events is a strong plus.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong negotiation and problem-solving abilities.
Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively.
Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive, can-do attitude.
Comfortable working in ambiguous environments and building processes from scratch.
Creative thinker with strong data-driven decision-making skills.
Skilled in crafting presentations and written pitch materials.
Fluency in English ; additional languages are a strong plus.

Unterstütze bei der Erstellung wissenschaftlicher Publikationen und Präsentationen.
Überwache regulatorische Anforderungen und stelle sicher, dass alle Projekte den gesetzlichen Vorgaben entsprechen.

Starshield leverages SpaceX’s Starlink technology and launch capability to support national security efforts. While Starlink is designed for consumer and commercial use, Starshield is designed for government use, with an initial focus on earth observation, communications, and hosted payloads. SpaceX Government Sales is expanding the team to support the deployment of Starshield capabilities for the U.S. Government.
SpaceX’s Government Program Development team is seeking a mission-oriented, results-driven Program Development Manager to grow the Starshield and AI business across U.S. Federal Civil agencies.

You will produce new business in logo accounts, and ensuring our partners help provide successful projects within your territory or region. You will work with Field Sales, Solution Sales specialists, Pre-sales, and the Customer Outcome teams to grow the pipeline.
You will be empowered to develop a joint go-to-market Territory plan featuring ServiceNow enabled service and workflow offerings. Strategies will feature "Sourced and Partner Impacted" NNACV, showcase wins and capacity metrics, and reflect regional Marketing plans and engagement with other ServiceNow sales solutions teams. Success will be measured by achievement of sales quotas for allocated accounts or territory on a quarterly and annual basis.

s.h: What you get to do in this role
s.t:
Work with ServiceNow partners to produce new business.
Ensure our partners help provide successful projects to customers.
Support joint sales pursuit activities to guide field interlock resulting in "Sourced" NNACV.
Accelerate account growth through joint go-to-market plans in consideration of ServiceNow's four C requirements: Capacity, Capability, Competency, and Customer Success.
Ensure Alliance operational thoughtfulness, consistency and business review governance with ServiceNow and executive partners from regional partners.
Develop capacity plans to assure partners are well positioned to sell the value of the Now Platform and to provide successful customer implementations (through proper competencies, certifications, and committed co-delivery plans).
Work with Marketing teams on both sides to build joint closed-loop demand generation plans (Partner Prospecting Days, CxO Roundtables and joint events).
Ensure the Partner strategy is following Value Selling (i.e., Value Prompter) and Now Value principles.

s.h: To be successful in this role you have

Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
Broad-based business and technology expertise with 10+ years in sales or 7+ years in either partner management or consulting
Experience driving successful business development activities
Experience working with organizations in multiple cities and markets
Experience partnering with multiple Sales teams to grow the partner ecosystem in a "win as a team" environment
Experience serving as a trusted advisor

Hey there!
We’re Fever , the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.
Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.
Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?
To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!
Ready to be part of the experience?
Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Business Development
At Fever, our Business Development team is both the face of Fever in the market and the voice of the market within Fever. Sitting at the core of our platform, they connect the world’s best experiences with the largest audiences, helping the live entertainment industry grow and evolve.
Our team builds trusted, long-term partnerships with leading brands across the ecosystem. We work closely with creators, producers, agencies, and cultural leaders to help them make data-driven decisions, expand their portfolios, and scale internationally. In doing so, we play a key role in shaping the future of the entertainment landscape.
This role goes far beyond relationship management. It requires strong strategic thinking and problem-solving across a wide range of topics, from marketing and pricing to operations and financing. The most successful team members take full ownership of their partners’ success, acting as true partners and advisors at every stage of growth.
Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Business Development works hand-in-hand with Marketing, Category Management, Partner Support, Operations, Tech, Product , and Finance to ensure every experience on our platform reaches its full potential.
Our team is diverse, entrepreneurial, and dynamic, bringing together talent from consulting, banking, big tech, and startups. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where creativity meets data, and ambition meets execution.
Join us if you’re passionate about discovering world-class experiences, building meaningful partnerships, and scaling some of the most exciting concepts across the globe.

Create and cultivate deep business relationships with the biggest producers, creators, venues and key stakeholders in the entertainment industry.
Develop and deliver a growth strategy for the market, with an innovative and effective approach to scaling Fever's presence in the region
Expertly manage commercial strategy with large partners ensuring value creation for both parties
Evidence strong organizational skills to effectively balance and grow a large base of clients
Collaborate closely with cross functional stakeholders to successfully deliver on partner growth across Brazil and internationally
Keep up to date with everything cool that’s happening in the entertainment; think of yourself as the expert for new and trending experiences

3+ years track record of success in sales or business development in a fast-paced environment (e.g. ticketing, entertainment, media, hospitality, or tech sales); consulting or partnerships experience also welcome
Proven track record of sales success in a fast-paced, quota carrying role
Strong business development and partnership management skills
Self-starter mentality with an ability to work in a demanding, dynamic start-up environment
Demonstrated data-driven approach to business and task prioritization
Excellent communication skills both written and verbal in English and Portuguese along with strong attention to detail
Comfort in working with Microsoft Office, Google docs, and a Sales CRM (Salesforce is preferred)
Knowledge of the city’s entertainment, events, and lifestyle trends

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles.

Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
The role of a Silicon Alliances Ecosystem Development Manager at Canonical
Ubuntu is the fastest growing enterprise Linux, the leading platform for public cloud computing, and the engineer's favorite way to drive the future.
Our goal is to help the enterprise embrace open source from end to end, across every class of compute and every class of application, starting with the linux kernel itself, to infrastructure solutions like OpenStack and Kubernetes, all the way up to data, security, analytics and serverless capabilities.
The Silicon Alliances Team works with the leading semiconductor companies to combine open source adoption with innovative optimizations to get the most from each new chip.

With our semiconductor partners, we develop joint product roadmaps, drive delivery, formulate go-to-market plans and conceptualize new business models, enabling differentiated hardware and robust product life-cycle support while still anchored to best-in-class Ubuntu.

The end goal is a frictionless experience to deploy, maintain, and develop on any hardware from cloud to edge.
The successful candidate is someone who is passionate about both hardware and software technology with interest to grow into business development. We are hiring for positions across early career to senior roles, with scope ranging from small exploratory partnerships to managing our largest and most strategic partnerships.
If you are someone who can navigate complex new technical challenges, learn quickly, and architect solutions and strategies across global teams, this challenging role is for you.
Location: We are hiring for remote roles in Americas. We will also consider applicants in EMEA who can accommodate a shifted schedule to support Silicon partners in Americas. Global travel to sprints, events, and partner meetings is part of the role.

s.h: What your day will look like
s.t:
Represent Canonical, its solutions and software to partners.
Develop a deep understanding of silicon partner strategies, technologies and roadmaps and identify overlap with Canonical’s current and future products.
Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing and sales teams to facilitate new business, leading definition of joint products, solutions and complex programs relying heavily on your communicating and influencing skills.
Ensure that robust project plans are created, tracked, and executed.
Develop joint Go To Market strategy and campaigns with silicon partners, manage market messaging, collateral and launch plans across products.
Negotiate successful contracts.

s.h: What we are looking for in you
s.t:
B.A / B.S / B.E degree in science, technology and/or engineering.
Fundamental understanding of the semiconductor industry and ecosystem.

s.h: Experience in software and system architecture is preferred.
s.t:
Customer-facing experience in business development, technology strategy or similar functions.
Excellent communication skills; ability to grasp complex material and synthesize key points.
Ability to think and work at both strategic and tactical levels
Disciplined and self motivated for a remote-first workplace environment.
Additional skills that you might also bring
Experience with open source software and open source business models is preferred.
Team leadership or program management experience.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company.

We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

You take strong end-to-end ownership or act as key support for strategy & execution of OD initiatives (depending on your seniority level) — from concept co-creation and rollout planning to stakeholder alignment, tooling setup, enablement, and impact tracking — and collaborate with other People & Business Operations functions and leadership to ensure solutions are embedded in day-to-day reality.
With plancraft currently at 150+ people, operating across 5 European countries, and further growing, this role is pivotal in helping to build the systems, routines, and standards that allow us to grow without losing speed, focus, or cultural strength.

Drive strategy & execution of organizational development initiatives (e.g. performance mgmt, total rewards, org design, internal comms) in close collaboration with the Head of P&O.
Help to translate strategic direction, org insights, and data into actionable solutions, such as frameworks, processes, templates, enablement materials, and decision artefacts.
Coordinate project-based collaboration with People & Business Operations functions and leadership to align requirements and ensure smooth execution.
Operationalize and continuously improve core people and org systems by building smart (AI-driven) workflows, practical toolkits, and enabling consistent standards.
Plan and run org-wide OD rollouts and enablement, including communications, training formats, documentation, and Q&A — driving adoption and tracking effectiveness.
Support org design and workforce planning by maintaining systems, planning artefacts and decision materials that enable leadership clarity and decision readiness.
Help to ensure high P&O data quality and deliver structured reporting and insights on progress, adoption, and improvement opportunities.

Must-Have Skills
3+ years in a highly generalistic role (e.g., Founder’s Associate, Chief of Staff, Strategy & Ops with strong P&O touchpoints) or a dedicated OD / HR Strategy role with broad exposure.
Organizational development foundation or equivalent experience in designing, structuring, operationalizing, and scaling org-wide initiatives end to end.
Strong process and systems thinking; able to turn strategy, qualitative signals, and data into scalable frameworks, workflows, and enablement that consistently enable the organization.
High ownership, strong attention to detail, and a structured, analytical way of working, with pragmatic follow-through in ambiguous situations.
Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills; comfortable working closely with leadership while staying execution-focused.
Strong affinity for data, documentation, and tooling (e.g., Notion, Slack, Sheets, AI tools).
Excellent communication skills both verbally and in writing in English (C1/C2 level), German skills are a plus.
If not based in Hamburg, open to come to our Hamburg HQ regularly (minimum 1x/quarter).
Nice-to-Have Skills
Exposure to total rewards, career frameworks, performance systems, or leadership development, AI-driven Org Design initiatives at scale.
Admin/builder-level experience in Personio, Leapsome, Notion, Ashby and Slack.
Experience in an organization that has already scaled through a similar growth stage (potentially multi-country/hybrid), ideally in the SaaS space.
Who this Role is for
This role is for a strategic, system-oriented builder who enjoys operating at the intersection of strategy, structure, and execution. You are someone who:
has a strong organizational development foundation and thinks in systems rather than isolated initiatives
enjoys co-creating concepts with senior stakeholders and taking responsibility for turning them into reality
combines structured, analytical thinking with pragmatic execution and stakeholder empathy
thrives in a high-trust, high-performance environment with clear ownership and expectations
measures success by adoption, clarity, and real behavior change
You are motivated by building foundations that scale — and by seeing your work shape how people lead, collaborate, and work every day.

Team Spirit : We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.
Ownership : You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.
Learning & Growth : We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.
AI Enablement : Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.
Tech & Tooling : You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.
Flexibility : Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.
Recharge : To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.
Mobility : You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

Role Overview We are seeking an experienced People & Culture Development Manager to lead workforce development, organizational effectiveness, and people capability-building initiatives within a high-growth, remote-first organization.

This role focuses on strengthening internal leadership capability, improving workforce discipline and accountability, optimizing HR processes, and ensuring compliance with labor regulations. The successful candidate will act as a key driver of culture, performance management, and organizational development across teams.

Key Responsibilities The People & Culture Development Manager will oversee the alignment of workforce needs across departments with recruitment and staffing functions, ensuring effective coordination between business units and talent acquisition teams.

The role involves interpreting organizational performance scorecards and using workforce data to drive accountability, operational discipline, and continuous improvement. The successful candidate will also identify gaps in team performance and implement structured interventions to improve outcomes.

A key responsibility includes designing and delivering upskilling programs aimed at strengthening employee capability and building internal leadership pipelines. This includes creating learning initiatives, workshops, and development pathways for high-potential employees.

The role also requires driving organizational structure and operational efficiency using process improvement methodologies, with a focus on reducing workflow inefficiencies and improving execution consistency across teams.

In addition, the People & Culture Development Manager will support workforce compliance by ensuring adherence to labor laws and contractor regulations, while also maintaining accurate documentation and HR process integrity.

The role involves leading initiatives related to employee engagement, culture development, retention, and performance management, ensuring alignment with organizational values and long-term growth objectives.

The successful candidate will also oversee compensation and benefits alignment, including benchmarking, rewards structures, and performance-based incentives to ensure competitiveness and fairness.

Furthermore, the role includes supporting onboarding and offboarding processes, workforce planning, and contractor lifecycle management, ensuring smooth transitions and compliance across all employment stages.

The People & Culture Development Manager will also be responsible for identifying early indicators of attrition or burnout, analyzing engagement trends, and implementing proactive retention strategies.

Qualifications & Experience The ideal candidate has 8–10 years of progressive experience in HR, People Operations, or organizational development , with at least 5 years in a leadership or management role . Strong experience in workforce management, employee engagement, performance management, and organizational development is required.

The candidate should have proven ability to manage cross-functional workforce needs and align recruitment and operational requirements. The role requires strong knowledge of labor laws and contractor compliance, particularly within Philippine employment and independent contractor frameworks.

Candidates should demonstrate strong capability in data interpretation, performance scorecards, and operational analytics to drive workforce accountability and improvement. Experience in coaching, training, and leadership development is essential, along with the ability to design and implement structured learning and capability-building programs.

Strong conflict resolution, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills are required, along with the ability to work in fast-paced, high-growth environments. Familiarity with process improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma is preferred.

Impact of the Role This role plays a critical part in shaping organizational culture, strengthening leadership capability, and driving workforce performance.

By aligning people strategy with operational execution, the People & Culture Development Manager ensures sustainable growth, improved accountability, and a high-performing organizational environment. Originally posted on Himalayas

Hey there!
We’re Fever , the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.
Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.
Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?
To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!
Ready to be part of the experience?
Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

We are looking for an exceptional, entrepreneurial Global Licensing Business Development Associate to join our dynamic and fast-paced Licensing team.
This is a high-impact business development role for someone with a strong commercial mindset and a passion for the entertainment industry. You will lead the expansion of our portfolio of live-event IPs across several international regions—identifying new opportunities, creating conversations with potential partners, and structuring partnerships that unlock sustainable growth.

As Global Licensing Associate, you will own the commercial development of assigned regions end-to-end: from mapping markets and originating new partner conversations to negotiating licensing agreements and coordinating their successful launch internally.
You will act as the face of the Licensing team in the market and bring market intelligence back into the organization, helping shape our international growth strategy and identify the next generation of licensing opportunities.

Develop and execute the business development strategy for assigned international regions, identifying high-potential markets, partners, and commercial opportunities.
Proactively source, approach, and build relationships with promoters, producers, agencies, venue operators, and other relevant partners.
Lead outbound commercial conversations and manage the full deal pipeline, from initial outreach through proposal development, negotiation, and contract execution.
Create tailored commercial proposals and licensing structures for different IPs, territories, and partner profiles.
Assess the commercial viability of opportunities through revenue, cost, and profitability analysis, working closely with Finance and other internal stakeholders.
Negotiate commercial terms that balance growth, profitability, brand protection, and long-term partner value.
Manage a portfolio of prospective and active partners, building trusted relationships and identifying opportunities to expand successful collaborations.
Collaborate closely with Legal, Finance, Operations, Marketing, and Production teams to ensure smooth deal execution and successful launches.
Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and new entertainment formats to inform licensing strategy and identify whitespace opportunities.
Maintain rigorous pipeline reporting, regularly presenting commercial progress, forecasts, and key decisions to leadership.

4+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, consulting, investment banking, strategic roles, or a similar commercial environment.
Demonstrated ability to originate opportunities, build senior-level relationships, and lead complex commercial conversations from first contact to close.
Strong commercial and negotiation skills, with the ability to structure compelling, mutually beneficial partnerships.
Analytical and financially minded, with experience building business cases, evaluating P&Ls, and assessing the profitability of new opportunities.
Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable operating with ownership in a fast-paced, international environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate ideas clearly and credibly to internal and external stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple deals, stakeholders, and priorities across regions.
Professional working proficiency in English is required. Additional languages are a strong plus.
A genuine interest in live entertainment, experiential formats, and building global IPs is highly valued.

Du sorgst dafür, dass aus einem guten Anlass ein gutes Gespräch wird.
VIAMA übernimmt für Unternehmen den laufenden Betrieb von Informationssicherheit und Governance. Unsere Kunden müssen Anforderungen wie NIS2, ISO 27001 oder TISAX nicht nur einmal umsetzen. Sie müssen sie dauerhaft betreiben.
Unser Vertrieb funktioniert deshalb etwas anders.
Wir kaufen keine beliebigen Leadlisten und erwarten von dir auch keine hundert wahllosen Kaltanrufe am Tag. Wir identifizieren gezielt Unternehmen, bei denen konkrete Signale auf einen möglichen Bedarf hinweisen. Zum Beispiel eine offene Informationssicherheitsrolle, eine laufende NIS2 Umsetzung oder andere Veränderungen im Unternehmen.
Deine Aufgabe ist es, aus diesen Signalen echte Gespräche zu machen.
Was du bei uns machst
Du übernimmst die operative Ansprache ausgewählter Unternehmen und begleitest einen Account so lange, bis klar ist, ob ein relevantes Thema für VIAMA besteht.

Du recherchierst die richtigen Ansprechpartner in unseren Zielunternehmen.
Du nimmst telefonisch Kontakt auf, auch über Zentralen und Assistenzbereiche.
Du führst erste Gespräche mit Geschäftsführern, IT-Verantwortlichen und Verantwortlichen für Informationssicherheit.
Du findest heraus, wo das Unternehmen bei Themen wie NIS2, ISO 27001 oder TISAX tatsächlich steht.
Du erkennst, ob ein konkreter Bedarf besteht und wann der richtige Zeitpunkt für ein weiteres Gespräch ist.
Du hältst Wiedervorlagen konsequent nach und lässt interessante Accounts nicht einfach verschwinden.
Du dokumentierst die wesentlichen Erkenntnisse sauber im CRM.
Sobald ein fachlich relevantes Gespräch entsteht, übergibst du an unseren Geschäftsführer oder einen unserer Governance-Experten.
Gemeinsam mit uns entwickelst du anhand echter Gespräche unsere Ansprache und unseren Vertriebsprozess weiter.
Du musst dabei keine komplexen Governance-Leistungen am Telefon verkaufen. Deine Aufgabe ist es, die richtige Person zu erreichen, die Situation zu verstehen und einen sinnvollen nächsten Schritt herzustellen.
Was wir nicht suchen
Wir suchen niemanden, der einfach möglichst viele Telefonnummern abarbeitet.
Wir suchen auch keinen klassischen Closer, der mit vorgefertigten Verkaufsskripten Druck erzeugt.
Unsere Zielgruppe besteht überwiegend aus Geschäftsführern und erfahrenen Fachverantwortlichen. Entsprechend wichtig ist uns eine Ansprache auf Augenhöhe.
Ein klares Nein ist für uns ein gutes Ergebnis, wenn wir anschließend wissen, warum ein Unternehmen nicht zu uns passt.
Was du mitbringen solltest
Du solltest gerne telefonieren und keine Scheu davor haben, Menschen anzusprechen, die dich noch nicht kennen.

VIAMA Leadership GmbH unterstützt mittelständische und größere Unternehmen beim Aufbau und vor allem beim dauerhaften Betrieb ihrer Governance.

Fleetio is looking for a Partner Development Manager to build and grow a portfolio of strategic reseller relationships — Fleet Management Companies (FMCs), telematics providers, and VARs — across the full partner lifecycle.

This is a true hunter-farmer role: you'll be equally accountable for sourcing, qualifying, and signing new reseller partners and for managing and growing the partners already in your book.

You're comfortable running a cold or warm partner pipeline from first conversation to signed agreement, and just as comfortable sitting across from an existing partner asking "where's our next dollar of growth together."
You'll work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Legal to build the partner pipeline, close new agreements, enable partners post-signature, and turn signed relationships into ramped, revenue-generating accounts.

New Partner Development
Identify, prospect, and qualify new reseller partner candidates across FMC, Telematics, and VAR segments, building and managing your own outbound pipeline.
Own the full sales cycle for new partner agreements — discovery, pitch, commercial negotiation, legal/redline coordination — through signature.
Score and prioritize prospective partners against Fleetio's qualification criteria (market fit, geographic fit, program maturity, pipeline potential) to focus effort on the highest-value opportunities.
Build relationships with executive sponsors at prospective partner organizations to secure buy-in and accelerate path-to-close.
Maintain an accurate, up-to-date view of the partner pipeline (stage, blockers, next actions, target ETA) in Salesforce/partner tracking tools.
Existing Partner Growth
Own a book of signed reseller partners end-to-end — from onboarding and enablement through renewal and expansion.
Build and maintain a shared definition of "growth" with each partner: agreed targets for assets under management, ARR, and pipeline, tracked consistently and revisited regularly.
Proactively identify incremental revenue opportunities within existing partner accounts — new segments, new use cases, underpenetrated regions, or expanded product attach.
Drive partner performance against joint business plans, holding partners (and internal stakeholders) accountable to commitments and timelines.
Support QBRs, joint marketing initiatives, and co-selling motions with key partners.
Across Both
Partner closely with internal Sales teams to ensure partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities are tracked, supported, and closed efficiently.
Develop a deep understanding of each partner's business model, competitive position, and channel economics in order to tailor Fleetio's value proposition and identify white space.
Represent the voice of the partner internally — surfacing blockers, feedback, and market intelligence to Product, Marketing, and Partnerships leadership.

10+ years of experience in partnerships, channel sales, or a strategic account management role — ideally in B2B SaaS, fleet, telematics, or a related vertical.
Demonstrated success in both new business development (sourcing and closing new partner/channel agreements) and account growth (expanding revenue within an existing partner book) — this is not a role for a pure hunter or a pure farmer.
A strong sales and commercial orientation: you think in terms of pipeline, ARR, attach rate, and growth levers, whether the partner is brand-new or five years in.
Proven track record of growing revenue through third-party partners/resellers, with concrete examples from both new-logo signing and existing-account expansion.
Comfort managing complex, multi-stakeholder deals — including commercial negotiation and coordinating through legal/contracting cycles.
Strong executive presence; experience building and maintaining relationships with senior partner stakeholders and sponsors, pre- and post-signature.
Highly organized and self-directed — able to manage a diverse portfolio of partners at very different stages (prospecting, qualification, contracting, ramping, mature) simultaneously.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting performance and plans to both partners and internal leadership.
Experience with CRM/partner tracking tools (Salesforce or similar) for pipeline and account management.
Familiarity with the fleet management, telematics, or FMC/VAR reseller landscape is a strong plus.
Bias toward action and ownership — you don't wait to be told where the next dollar of growth is, whether that's a brand-new partner or an existing one; you go find it.

Get to know Climeworks
Climeworks is a leading high-quality carbon removal provider, combining decades of expertise in Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology with a holistic approach to carbon removal solutions.
Climeworks advises companies on their carbon removal strategies and provides tailored portfolios of nature-based and engineered approaches, offering end-to-end services to help achieve net-zero goals. The company runs the world's first two DAC plants in Iceland, demonstrating its core commitment to high-quality carbon removal that is backed by over 15 years of pioneering research, development, and deployment.
By advancing the most reliable solutions in the market, Climeworks accelerates the global transition to net zero, unlocking economic value for businesses, governments, and society.
We foster a dynamic environment and are building a global purpose driven team. We are looking for disruptive thinkers, passionate achievers and inspiring leaders that are ready to take on the world’s greatest challenge.
Will you join us?

Job description
Climeworks Solutions is a leading provider of high-quality carbon removal solutions. Our customer base includes more than 200 multinational companies, representing over 50% of the Forbes Global 2000 companies engaged in carbon dioxide removal (CDR). As demand for high-quality CDR is expected to grow exponentially over the coming decades, Climeworks Solutions aims to play a leading role in scaling this emerging market and shaping its future.
We combine a holistic approach to carbon removal portfolio design with over a decade of hands-on expertise in CDR, built through our pioneering work in Direct Air Capture technology. Climeworks Solutions advises organisations on their carbon removal strategies and delivers curated portfolios across both nature-based and engineered solutions, providing end-to-end services to support the achievement of their climate goals.
By advancing the most competitive and highest-quality solutions in the CDR market, Climeworks Solutions accelerates the global transition to net zero while unlocking economic value for businesses, governments, and society.
As a Senior Partnership Development Manager at Climeworks Solutions, your mission is to take the lead to grow our business in Europe and North America across several industries. You develop an accurate understanding of the market, build the required value proposition and dedicated business cases, as well as the go-to-market strategy to be successful.
Strategic Account Development: You develop your own pipeline by identifying and prioritizing promising accounts, connecting to key stakeholders within the customers’ organization and developing strong relationships with key contacts across all levels of seniority.
Climate Strategy & CDR Advisory: You lead the offering process by analyzing carefully customers’ needs and climate strategy. You advise them on their net-zero journey, build the business case for CDR, and design tailored proposals for CDR portfolios, along with a team of cross-functional experts.
Business Development & Industry Engagement: You represent Climeworks Solutions at leading conferences & industry events. You initiate communication campaigns, you leverage Climeworks Solutions’ network and your own network to develop new opportunities.
Partnerships & Alliance Management: You maintain and develop relationships with industry alliances and associations that can contribute to your commercial success.
Commercial Negotiation Leadership: You lead the negotiation phases, orchestrating the contribution of all required departments and specialists.
Customer Success & Portfolio Management: You are in charge of successful account management (customer success). You supervise the delivery of carbon dioxide removal credits and bring the right market & portfolio insights to the respective customers.
Your story

What Drives You: You are excited to build a new (climate relevant) industry with a trillion-dollar market potential. You like the prospect of building a successful business in that industry – the carbon removal industry, along with a highly dedicated and fun team. You are comfortable with complexity and you develop strategic approaches to win challenging opportunities.
Educational Background: You have completed a bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Sustainability, Climate, Engineering or in a related field; Master’s degree or equivalent advanced degree is a plus.
Experience: You have a strong track record in developing businesses in new markets and in environments evolving quickly. You benefit from at least 8 years’ experience in commercial positions with B2B accounts. You have been successfully working in positions requiring an entrepreneurial mindset and a builder attitude (e.g. in start-up or scale-up environments).
Skills & Strengths: You have strong leadership skills with focus on being inspiring and developing trust with your customers. You are a great networker, analytical and strategically strong. You thrive in agile environments and adapt confidently to change. You are well-versed in orchestrating the Go-to-market across different teams with strong project management skills.
Language & Communication: You have excellent English skills (C2), and you are an inspiring speaker and comfortable with public presentations. You can craft clear, engaging and structured narratives.
Our promise: At Climeworks, you are accepted for who you are, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply – regardless of background, identity, or experience.

Studies show that women and individuals from minority backgrounds often only apply for jobs when they meet 100% of the listed criteria. If this sounds like you, don’t hold back. If you think you’d make a great fit for this role, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t check every single box.

Let’s tackle one of humankind’s greatest challenges together.

Time Off: Enjoy 25 paid vacation days every year, plus public holidays.
Flexibility: Work how it suits you best. We offer a hybrid work setup and up to 4 weeks of remote work annually within any EU country.
Ownership: Fair base pay paired with an equity package – because your contributions matter.
Family Support: Inclusive parental leave.
Continuous Learning: Dedicated budget to invest in your professional growth.
Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team and earn bonuses for your successful referrals.
Salary: At Climeworks, salary ranges are assigned to a job based on the level of seniority and the location specific market median of similar jobs according to external benchmark surveys. Individual compensation depends on your skills, experience, and the value you bring to the team.

This position is based in Opfikon, Zurich, and we ask that you work onsite at least three days per week.

AI and Hiring at Mentimeter
At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.
AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.
AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.

Market Development Manager Electrician Segment (w/m/d)
======================================================
**Arbeiten bei Feller by Schneider Electric \- We are your Energy Technology Partner**
Schneider Electric ist der Ort, an dem Deine Arbeit echten Impact schafft. Indem wir die Welt elektrifizieren, automatisieren und digitalisieren, treiben wir die Energiewende aktiv voran. Du wirst Teil inklusiver Teams, die an sinnvollen Herausforderungen arbeiten und Deine Fähigkeiten in Lösungen einbringen, die Industrien, Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten nachhaltiger machen.
Als **Market Development Manager Electrician Segment (m/w/d)** verantwortest Du die Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Marketingstrategie für den «Electrician Channel» in der Schweiz.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Produktmanagement, MarCom und weiteren Stakeholdern sorgst Du dafür, dass Kundenbedürfnisse, Marktanforderungen und Unternehmensziele in erfolgreiche Marketing\- und Aktivierungsprogramme übersetzt werden.

Du bist die Stimme unserer Kunden, entwickelst innovative Go\-to\-Market\-Strategien und trägst aktiv zum nachhaltigen Wachstum unserer Marken, Lösungen und Services bei.

* **Wann und wo?** Ab sofort in Horgen
* **Dauer:** Unbefristet
* **Urlaub:** Mindestens 25 Tage
* **Wochenstunden:** 40 Stunden
* **Deine Ansprechperson?** Larissa Niederberger als Recruiterin für diese Position

* Ein Job mit Zukunft: Bei uns kannst Du Deine Karriere langfristig planen und Dich nach eigenen Wünschen weiterentwickeln.

* Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Marketingstrategie für unsere Zielgruppe der Elektrofachkräfte in der Schweiz
* Analyse von Kundenbedürfnissen, Markttrends und Wachstumspotenzialen
* Konzeption und Steuerung von Programmen zur Kundengewinnung, Kundenbindung und Aktivierung
* Planung und Umsetzung von Go\-to\-Market\-Aktivitäten für Produkt\-, Lösungs\- und Serviceeinführungen

* Erfahrung im technischen Umfeld sowie im Marketing von Produkten, Lösungen oder Dienstleistungen
* Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung sowie analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten
